title.narrative: Protection Mainstreaming Working Group FY1920 onwards.

description.narrative:
THIS IS A CONTINUATION OF PROJECT GID051. ALL CONTENT (INC BUDGET) ASSUMES END DATE OF APRIL 2020 BUT THE PROJECT MAY BE EXTENDED UNTIL SEPT 2020.
There is growing consensus across the humanitarian sector that all humanitarian actors share an ethical responsibility to mainstream protection across their work, ensuring their activities promote meaningful access, safety and dignity of disaster affected populations.
As such, CAFOD, CRS, Trocaire and Caritas Australia have committed to a joint initiative, the Protection Mainstreaming Working Group (PMWG), to strengthen their own capacity and that of their partners in order to be more strategic and consistent in mainstreaming protection throughout emergency response and recovery programmes. In order to ensure this working is effective, CAFOD will host the Protection Mainstreaming Coordinator – a shared post working with all 4 agencies.
The PMWG will seek to strengthen protection mainstreaming through building widespread commitment and providing practical support to the implementation of protection mainstreaming; developing and promoting good practice and continual learning in relation to protection mainstreaming; ensuring representation and participation within relevant international protection fora and developing strategic links with the wider Caritas network.
The role of the Protection Mainstreaming (PM) Coordinator will be to provide essential coordination and leadership for this initiative across the four organizations. They will be responsible for finalizing and rolling out a common PM framework in collaboration with the PMWG. The PM Coordinator will provide technical leadership, manage the roll-out process for the framework and a related minimum package of PM tools/guidance, and represent the organizations within international protection fora.
